en: Black‑and‑white elevated view over a grand spa promenade lined with ornate cast‑iron colonnades and domed pavilions. Crowds in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll along the wide walkways. On the right is a straight avenue with horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians, flanked by multi‑story buildings with balconies. In the distance are wooded hills and scattered villas typical of a Central European spa town.
